opening_filter: Twenty named opening families, two seeded quiet continuations each, sorted legal move choices. No evaluator queried or evaluation/outcome filter. Frozen before games; nested prefixes; reversed colors. Additional 30-game cohort uses original pairs 6–20; prior 10 games used pairs 1–5. No opening overlap.

summary.uncertainty_method: Hoeffding bounded pair-score 95% interval; nominal independent opening pairs
summary.limitations: Frozen evaluator-neutral opening book; capped pairs excluded from complete-pair inference; no universal Elo claim. Null rating endpoints mean unbounded tails.
